title: Quest closure text for 'Quill's Ballot' reads 'Quest closed: Quill's Ballot - its asker's wish is past meeting' after handing the bribe purse to the Watch instead of delivering it - serviceable but the phrase 'past meeting' is an odd/stiff way to say the quest resolved in a way Quill didn't want.
where: The Watch House - 'hand Quill's coin to the Watch'
